_comment: Default bridge rules for the Vyne dynamic engine. Users can override by placing a file at <gameDir>/.vyne/bridges.json. Only add entries here when the auto-synthesized default (return null/zero) isn't semantically correct.

classes._comment: NeoForge client datagen model hierarchy. Registrate and similar mods reference these from blockstate/item model builders. The stub synthesizer defaults unknown classes to `java/lang/Object`, which can trip the verifier when a `ModelBuilder` must be assignable to `ModelFile`. Mirror the NeoForge supertype chain (ModelFile <- ModelBuilder <- {BlockModelBuilder, ItemModelBuilder}) so verification passes on dedicated servers.
ModelFile$UncheckedModelFile is a public inner subclass of ModelFile used by Registrate's `RegistrateItemModelProvider.generated` as the fallback parent when a mod doesn't supply its own model.
Mirror of the above for the older minecraftforge package path so pre-port mods still verify.

Client player hierarchy stubs. AbstractClientPlayer (class_742) is the common super of LocalPlayer (class_746). Render handlers like ShootableGadgetRenderHandler use both; COMPUTE_FRAMES needs this relationship or the verifier rejects the class on a dedicated server where these are not in the game jar.

NeoForge fluid hierarchy: `BaseFlowingFluid` must subtype Mojmap `FlowingFluid` (1.21+ intermediary `class_3609`, not `class_3610` which is final `FluidState`). Chain: Fluid <- FlowingFluid <- BaseFlowingFluid <- {Source, Flowing}.
Legacy minecraftforge package mirror of the fluid hierarchy.
NeoForge ships DeferredSoundType under common/util; must extend vanilla SoundType (class_2498) for block property APIs.
MekFakePlayer extends NeoForge FakePlayer; if FakePlayer is synthesized as Object, the subtype is not assignable to Entity (class_1297) when passed to loot APIs (TileEntityDigitalMiner.getDrops).

methods._comment: FMLJavaModLoadingContext.getModEventBus — Forge-flavor return type. Our shim only declares the NeoForge-return overload (Java disallows return-only overloads), so mods compiled against Forge (e.g. Traveler's Backpack) get an AUTO_DEFAULT null and crash in <init> on addListener(). Route through a neutral bridge method so the INVOKESTATIC targetDesc is an actual existing method descriptor (VyneEventBus.global() returns VyneEventBus, not Object — that caused a NoSuchMethodError on the first try).
methods.name: getModEventBus

methods._comment: Same for the NeoForge-flavor bus package — keep both mapped so a mod compiled against either variant gets a live bus.
methods.name: getModEventBus

methods._comment: Some mods import ModLoadingContext (not FMLJavaModLoadingContext) and call getActiveContainer/getModEventBus through that. Route identically.
methods.name: getModEventBus

methods._comment: Fluid#getFluidType() — Forge-namespace call site. DynamicBridgeEngine keys its catalog lookup on the raw descriptor it scanned from the mod jar (pre VyneRemapper); TB and most 1.21.1 Forge-port mods still ship bytecode that declares the return type as net/minecraftforge/fluids/FluidType. AUTO_DEFAULT (null) NPE'd inside TB EffectFluidRegistry#registerFluidEffect. The targetDesc's return type is the live class in Vyne's classpath; VyneRemapper rewrites net/minecraftforge/ → net/neoforged/neoforge/ at class-load so the CHECKCAST types line up at runtime.
methods.name: getFluidType

methods._comment: Codec.intRange(int,int) — Forge/NeoForge-added static extension on com/mojang/serialization/Codec. DynamicBridgeEngine's hierarchy-aware method translator spots the same (II)LCodec; signature on net/minecraft/class_5699.method_48766 (ExtraCodecs.intRange) and rewrites the shim name to method_48766 while keeping the owner as Codec, then fails isMethodResolvable because Codec itself doesn't declare it — falls through to AUTO_DEFAULT (null) and NPEs TB's BackpackContainerContents$Slot.<clinit>. Route the call straight to ExtraCodecs.intRange, which is the exact implementation NeoForge's patch delegates to.
methods.name: method_48766

methods._comment: Same getFluidType extension, NeoForge-namespace variant — some mod jars already compile against net/neoforged/neoforge/fluids/FluidType directly.
methods.name: getFluidType
